en.name: John I
en.summary: A pope sent unwillingly to Constantinople by the Arian king Theodoric and imprisoned on his return, dying shortly afterward as a result.
en.body: John I was compelled by the Ostrogothic king Theodoric, an Arian Christian growing suspicious of his Catholic Roman subjects' ties to the Byzantine emperor, to lead an embassy to Constantinople seeking relief for Arians in the East. Though received with great honor there, he returned to find Theodoric's suspicion undiminished; he was imprisoned at Ravenna, where he died from the harsh conditions, and is venerated as a martyr.
